title: Durchsuchungen wegen Verdachts des Menschenhandels und der Arbeitsausbeutung

extraction.summaryEn: Police, prosecutors and customs searched three properties in Mitte, Friedrichshain and Kreuzberg in an investigation into suspected human trafficking for labour exploitation against eight suspects. Four workers were found at a kitchen-accommodation site, which was closed for hygiene and fire-safety deficiencies.
